due_when.clears_when: a fresh cloud lane session runs scripts' prepush (guards + pytest + ruff) green WITHOUT manual pip installs or PATH edits, i.e. the pinned ruff (<0.16) and repo requirements are on PATH first in the session environment (setup script or a repo-side bootstrap the prepush calls)

origin.ref: Manager Session 2026-11-05b (session_01AFoLuLmhUKeUzHC6CHz2uP), reported by lane ML-FS-RECIPE (session_01AFoLuL5SYTWKXeuE1pfqzX) at 22:24Z while opening #23516
origin.rerun: in a fresh cloud session at the repo root: which ruff; ruff --version; grep -n ruff requirements*.txt pyproject.toml; run the repo prepush and read whether ruff/fastapi/import-linter failures are environmental

what: Cloud lane sandboxes ship ruff 0.16.9 first on PATH, shadowing the repo pin (<0.16, 0.15.12), and lack the repo requirements (fastapi, import-linter). Prepush therefore fails or lies until the lane installs requirements and puts the pinned ruff first (MEASURED by lane ML-FS-RECIPE 2026-11-05: after that, guards 79/0/0 and 5,372 tests passed). Each lane re-discovers this and burns a turn; some earlier 'prepush failures' were environmental. Fix: make prepush self-bootstrap the pinned toolchain (or an environment setup script), Tier 1.
